summary: ansible-core 2.13 module execution needs Python 2.7 or Python 3.5+ on targets; module_utils.basic won't work on older Python.
questions: Can ansible-core 2.13 manage a host with Python 2.6?
What's the minimum target Python for ansible-core 2.13?

answer_card.title: Target Python 2.7 or 3.5+
answer_card.answer_md: ansible-core 2.13 modules need **Python 2.7** or **Python 3.5+** on managed nodes. Older versions (such as 2.6) don't work with `ansible.module_utils.basic`; use `raw` to bootstrap a newer Python.
